cron_id.source: fresh exact Cron inventory or create-response readback

rules: Resolve every identifier from fresh Development Audit readback immediately before a separately approved write.
Require the private project, Function pool, and Job function names to match the public names in this contract before binding their IDs.
Substitute every placeholder with its required type in private runtime memory; never commit, print, log, or infer an identifier.
A missing, duplicate, stale, differently named, or differently typed binding blocks the write.

completeness_gates: Prove that data is the complete untruncated array for the authenticated Development project; an empty, malformed, partial, capped, or pagination-ambiguous response never proves absence.
Require every item to expose a lossless ID, exact name, execution type, and status; an invalid item blocks all classification.

Because the documented inventory is pre-defined-only, independently prove that no dynamic, expression, one-time, or other execution-type Cron can collide on RevenueAnalytics1m; if an all-type name inventory is unavailable, absent classification and create remain blocked.

classification_rules.absent: Complete all-type name-collision proof plus complete pre-defined inventory contains zero exact-name matches.
classification_rules.exact: Exactly one lossless exact-name pre-defined match exists, its get-by-ID normalized projection equals the phase-specific canonical projection, and the closed-world exact_behavior_field_policy passes without an absent-unproven or unknown field.
classification_rules.drifted: Exactly one lossless exact-name pre-defined match exists but its singular readback differs from the canonical projection or fails any closed-world behavior-field condition.
classification_rules.duplicate: More than one exact-name match exists in any execution type, or cross-type collision exclusion is incomplete after any match is observed.

inventory_readback.stop_gate: No branch may run until inventory array shape, item types, completeness, pagination behavior, and all-execution-type name-collision exclusion are proven.

provider_generated_exact_relations: data.id must losslessly equal the bound Cron ID and the get-by-ID request path ID.
data.project_details, when scalar, or its shape-proven ID member must losslessly equal the bound Development project ID.
data.job_meta.id must be a lossless stable persisted Job-definition ID; it is not a submitted execution Job ID.
data.cron_detail.jobId, if the proven response schema contains it, must losslessly equal data.job_meta.id and is never a submitted execution Job ID.

data.job_meta.jobpool_id and shape-proven data.job_meta.jobpool_details.id must losslessly equal the bound pool ID; pool name, type, project ID, and memory must equal RevenueDeskAnalyticsJobs, Function, the bound project ID, and 512 respectively.
data.job_meta.source_details.id and any data.job_meta.source_id must losslessly equal the bound Cron ID; source_name and details.cron_execution_type must equal RevenueAnalytics1m and pre-defined.
data.job_meta.target_details.id and data.job_meta.target_id must losslessly equal the bound function ID; target name and type must equal analytics_sync and Function.
Provider-created or modified audit metadata may be retained as readback evidence only; it must never be copied into a status body.
rules: The four advertised-field buckets are mutually exclusive and their union must equal the complete advertised connector body leaf-path inventory before exact classification or any status mutation.

A canonical-absent field must be literally absent in a fresh shape-proven readback. Null, empty, zero, an injected default, or an omitted path whose absence was not proven is not equivalent to absence.

Every advertised field, known provider-only path, and shape variant must either materialize with its required exact value or have its absence proven by the fresh response-shape contract; an unobserved path is not evidence of absence.
Every provider-generated identity or integrity field must satisfy its exact relation, and every provider metadata field must remain readback-only.

Any unknown, unmapped, differently nested, or newly exposed key under data, cron_detail, job_meta, job_config, jobpool_details, capacity, source_details, target_details, headers, params, or request bodies blocks exact classification, create, status mutation, activation, canary acceptance, and deletion until this contract and its tests are reviewed.

normalization_rules: Require a fresh private Audit response to match every documented raw path and type before using this projection; an opaque, missing, renamed, or differently typed field blocks create and activation.
Normalize documented numeric Cron schedule and retry fields to finite nonnegative integers before exact comparison; request strings are never treated as readback strings.
Read target name and identifier only from target_details and pool name and type only from jobpool_details; request-shaped fallback fields are forbidden.
Compare private identifiers only through a lossless exact representation. An unsafe JSON number or any ambiguous conversion blocks comparison.

After normalization and private binding substitution, compose expected_normalized_projection_base with the exact phase-specific cron_status and require deep equality plus a passing exact_behavior_field_policy.
provider_readback.stop_gate: If fresh Audit shape proof or lossless execution identity is unavailable, perform no create, update, activation, canary, or deletion and preserve mode-first containment.

status_change.advertised_connector_shape: headers plus path_variables with Cron and project IDs plus the complete Cron body

prerequisites: Fresh read-only evidence must prove the connector issues the provider's status-only PATCH or otherwise prove nonreplacement semantics; never infer this from the tool name or description.
The exact Cron must pass the closed-world advertised-field inventory, every canonical-absent field must be proven absent, every provider identity relation must match, and no unknown field may exist.

If the connector can replace configuration from the advertised full body, these canonical templates are not executable because they intentionally omit provider-generated identity and readback-only metadata; stop for a new reviewed packet instead of reconstructing a body.
full_body_safety_gate.unproven_action: keep ANALYTICS_SYNC_MODE=disabled, perform no status write, preserve the Cron definition, record Cron containment as unproven, and stop

rules: Prove which advertised status body shape the connector actually accepts before the first status write; do not probe by mutation.

Use the full-body template only after exact canonical readback and the complete exact_behavior_field_policy prove every behavior, side-effect, identity, absent, and unknown-field condition and read-only evidence proves nonreplacement status semantics.
Never use the canonical full-body template to disable a drifted or duplicate Cron because it could overwrite predecessor state.
If a safe status-only shape is not proven for drifted or duplicate prestate, keep ANALYTICS_SYNC_MODE=disabled, preserve the Cron definitions, record disabled-Cron containment as unproven, and stop.

mode_first_containment: Set ANALYTICS_SYNC_MODE=disabled and independently read back the exact function configuration before any Cron create, update, disable, activation, rollback, or deletion.

Use status_change to disable a same-name Cron and read back cron_status=false only after its safe connector shape is proven; otherwise retain mode disabled, record Cron containment as unproven, and stop before another mutation.
Drain every known or newly discovered associated Job to an independently read-back terminal state; if execution inventory is incomplete, drain is unproven and activation, mutation, or deletion stops.

forbidden_job_id_sources: Job metadata, pool, target, or function IDs
job_drain.unknown_or_nonterminal_action: keep the mode disabled, preserve every proven Cron status and definition, record Cron containment and Job drain as unproven, and stop

prestate_branches.absent: After mode-first containment, fresh Audit response-shape proof, and exact private binding, create the exact disabled definition once and require normalized exact provider readback.
prestate_branches.exact: Perform no create or update; preserve the one exact Cron disabled and repeat exact provider readback.
prestate_branches.drifted: Keep the mode disabled; only with proven safe status shape disable and read back the one same-name Cron. Otherwise record Cron containment unproven. Drain only proven Job IDs, preserve the predecessor definition privately, and stop for separately scoped remediation.
prestate_branches.duplicate: Keep the mode disabled; only with proven safe status shape disable and read back every same-name Cron. Otherwise record Cron containment unproven. Drain only proven Job IDs, preserve all definitions privately, and stop without selecting or deleting a winner.

rollback_branches.created_from_absent: After mode-first containment and Job drain, delete only when the fresh live packet explicitly authorizes deletion of the exact packet-created Cron ID as conditional rollback; otherwise preserve it disabled.
rollback_branches.preexisting_exact: Do not delete or replace it; preserve the exact predecessor disabled and read it back again.
rollback_branches.drifted_or_duplicate: Do not update, consolidate, or delete under this contract. Preserve every affected definition; if safe status shape is unavailable, keep the mode disabled and record Cron containment unproven until fresh exact remediation and deletion authority exists.
rollback_branches.ambiguous_create: Re-list through the complete inventory contract, classify every same-name result as duplicate prestate, drain only proven Job IDs, and perform no retry or deletion without fresh exact authority; if safe status shape is unavailable, record Cron containment unproven.

conditional_delete.destructive_effect: Permanently deletes the exact Cron and all associated execution history; the operation cannot be undone.
prerequisites: A fresh live packet must explicitly authorize conditional deletion of the exact packet-created Cron ID after absent prestate; repository approval and this contract do not authorize it.
Mode-first containment and exact disabled Cron readback must succeed through a proven safe status shape.
Provider-complete execution inventory and terminal drain must be proven, and required sanitized private evidence must be preserved before history is destroyed.
success_readback: Re-run the complete all-execution-type name-collision and pre-defined inventory contract and require the exact Cron ID and name to be absent.
A fresh get-by-ID must return the provider's shape-proven not-found result for the exact Cron ID; an opaque failure is not deletion proof.

inventory.required_result: complete pre-defined inventory plus separate all-execution-type proof contains neither the exact Cron ID nor RevenueAnalytics1m

resource.required_result: fresh shape-proven provider not-found result for the exact Cron ID

conditional_delete.ambiguous_outcome: Never retry deletion. Preserve ANALYTICS_SYNC_MODE=disabled, re-run both independent readbacks for the exact ID and name, retain all remaining definitions and evidence, and stop for fresh authority if absence is not proven.

required_equalities: The lossless manual-submit response data.job_id must equal TBD_PRIVATE_ANALYTICS_JOB_ID, the get-by-ID request path ID, and the get-by-ID response data.job_id.
The readback source_type must equal Cron, and source_details.id, source_name, and details.cron_execution_type must exactly equal the submitted Cron ID, RevenueAnalytics1m, and pre-defined.
A Job reached by a different ID or attributed only by pool, target, parameters, name, or time window is not canary evidence.

terminal_job_readback.missing_or_ambiguous_metadata_action: keep the mode and Cron disabled and stop without claiming canary acceptance
